sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action(['DOWN']*7)
def bboxes(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('piece','B'),('gray','c'),('yellow','Y')]:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
        out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),len(cells))
    return out
print(bboxes(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
